Great spiritual leaders shared one habit in hard times.

Kevin Trudeau looks at figures like Krishna, Jesus, Buddha and Muhammad and the stretches of trial or exile in their stories. He says the pattern is always the same.

Number one, they did not look at it as adversity. Kevin suggests comparing how they responded with how we respond, then applying it in your own life.

When you face a hard stretch, what would change if you did not label it adversity?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

Why a painful moment may hold the seed of something better.

Kevin Trudeau says spiritual masters understood that the way through is the only way out. They let their karma come in and transform rather than fighting it.

His point: the universe does not do things to you, it does things for you. He says every painful situation holds the seed of a greater benefit, and calls it spiritually proven and scripturally documented.

What hard moment in your life ended up helping you?
